name: Gomen! Dai-chan! Onee-chan Ochi○po Haechatta!!!
original_name: ごめん!だいちゃん!お姉ちゃんおち○ぽ生えちゃった!!!
source:
The gentle big sis suddenly grows a dick in the groin.
Even worse, once it's erected, she attacks anyone mindlessly.
Her family try to stop this.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170159.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
温柔的姐姐突然在胯间长出了一根阴茎。
更糟的是，一旦勃起，她就会失去理智地攻击任何人。
她的家人试图阻止她。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE170159.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
